high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a blog post from a website. The post is titled "Hard vs Soft Boundary Conditions in PINNs: What's the Difference and Why It Matters." It is written by the Elastropy Team on August 08, 2025. The content of the post discusses the differences between hard and soft boundary conditions when using Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) to solve Partial Differential Equations (PDEs). The text explains that in traditional numerical methods, boundary conditions are enforced rigidly, meaning the solution must satisfy them.
